source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Locate the *number* of violations in the violation column. In the example below, there is a total of 3 violations in 2017.
3. Download the sample water-quality test report and complete it for each day of violation
  * Start at the 6th data point in the first row and highlight 3 consecutive days (for each column of violations in the test report)
  * Repeat this for the number of violations from the row 1 violation column and paste it into the test report
  * Save an image or PDF of the test report for each day of violation

![](https://i.imgur.com/bJ3kCWF.png)
